title: 21.21. Hetuduka, Vitakkattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nahetuṁ nasavitakkasavicāraṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca hetu savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Nahetuṁ naavitakkavicāramattaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca hetu avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Nahetuṁ naavitakkaavicāraṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi, adhipatiyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
